caption: The drawing consists of two main sections on a beige background. At the top, there is a line drawing of a vase or jar with two side handles, outlined in blue. Inside the upper part of the jar, a blue, brushstroke-style motif surrounds the text “HOWE & CLARK ATHENS.” Below this, in the lower two-thirds of the composition, there is a rectangular area with a textured, mottled brown and gray background. Within this rectangular area, there is an abstract, organic shape in varying shades of blue, with highlights of brown in the center. The organic shape appears almost floral, with curved, petal- or leaf-like elements. The artist’s signature, “Yolande Delasser,” is present at the lower left corner of the image.
title: Crock
